title: Duration selection before exercise
story: As a user, I want to select a duration before starting an exercise so that I can control how long my writing session lasts.
acceptance_criteria: A start screen is shown before the exercise begins, displaying duration options: 1s, 10s, 30s, 10m
The 10m option is selected by default when the start screen loads
The user can select a different duration before starting
The exercise runs for exactly the selected duration
On the results page, clicking 'Start new session' (or equivalent) returns the user to the duration selection start screen
Selected duration does not persist across page refreshes
agent_retro: The existing button label 'Start New Exercise' didn't match the AC's 'Start new session' wording. I wrote the test using the AC's wording first, causing a spurious failure. Should check existing UI text against AC wording before writing tests.
user_retro: At the end of the do-task command, the agent renamed the lockfile. This meant that the close-task command didn't execute as expected. Also, it's renaming to `.done.json` which is not needed at this point.
